view_frame: Front view (primary) shows X width and Z height. Top view shows X width and Y depth. Right view (not shown) would show Y depth and Z height. Origin is at the bottom-front-left corner of the box.

features.evidence: Outer rectangle in front view (XZ) and top view (XY).
Inner rectangle in front view (XZ) and top view (XY).

connections: box_inner is subtracted from box_outer to create the open-top box.
window is subtracted from the front wall of the box.
edit_rules: Changing wall_thickness_mm updates box_inner dimensions and position.
Changing floor_thickness_mm updates box_inner Z start position.
Changing window_width_mm or window_height_mm updates window dimensions and position.
Changing box_outer dimensions updates all dependent features.

clarification.reason: The drawing does not specify the wall thickness or floor thickness of the box.
